cohort: Low birth weight babies born at Patan Hospital, Nepal between April 2017 and March 2020.
finding: Respiratory distress syndrome (35%) and sepsis (29%) were the most common causes of neonatal mortality among low birth weight babies.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 1185 grams, median 1045 grams, with standard deviation 571 grams and range of 500 to 2484 grams.
